explanation: The theorem says that slashing with a scalar matrix r•1 (r ≠ 0) in GL₂(ℝ) at weight 2 is the identity. I read the lemma list of Mathlib/NumberTheory/ModularForms/SlashActions.lean. It has slash_def, slash_apply, smul_slash, SL_slash, mul_slash and similar lemmas, but nothing about scalar or central matrices. I also grepped all of Mathlib for slash combined with scalar, central, center, algebraMap, smul_one and -1, and found nothing relevant. I found no general lemma that a central element acts trivially, or as a scalar, under the slash action. Files that mention slash also include Identities.lean, Basic.lean and SlashInvariantForms.lean, and none of them has such a lemma.
